messages:
Ana: Morning team — quick triage update. Current queue ~48 tickets, ~5 high-priority, two related to the embeddings ingestion pipeline. I'll list actions below.
Mike: Thanks — what are the 5 high-priority ones? IDs?
Ana: P1s: INC-3123 (ingest failures), INC-3127 (billing spike), INC-3130 (dedicated node OOM), INC-3132 (SAML login loop), INC-3135 (api latency on /v1/generate).
Jo: I picked up INC-3127, doing invoice reconciliation now. ETA ~2h.
Li: I'm on INC-3130 — reproducing on staging, looks like a mem leak in kv cache when sequence > 8k.
Sara: For INC-3123 (embeddings) I saw errors: `rpc: timeout after 30s` and `invalid vector dim`. Could be upstream transform.
Ana: Good catch Sara. Can you paste the failing payload (redacted) in the threads?
Sara: Pasted sample. Payload has missing `model_version` field. I think the client lib defaulted to legacy behavior.
Mike: I can send a small patch to the client shim to default `model_version` for older clients. Will open PR.
Jo: Re: macros — please update the customer-facing macro for embeddings failures. Current macro points to the old troubleshooting doc. New macro should mention `check model_version` and link to /docs/embeds-troubleshooting.
Ana: New macro draft (please copy/paste into Support macros):
```
Macro: Embeddings ingestion failure
Steps:
1) Ask for sample payload and model_version
2) Verify `vector_dim` matches model spec
3) Suggest client update if model_version missing
4) Escalate to infra if `rpc timeout` persists after 3 retries
Links: https://redwood.ai/docs/embeds-troubleshooting
```
Jo: I'll publish that macro now and add a short canned reply referencing INC-3123.
ops-bot: Automated alert: region-us-east-1 error rate for embed-write increased by 3.2x in the last 15m.
Li: Correlating with my reproduction — staging worker shows same pattern, looks like new quantized kernels causing fallback thrash. Tagging @eng-runtime in case we need a rollback.
Mike: PR opened: github.com/redwood/client-shim/pull/621 — sets `model_version` for legacy calls. Link in INC-3123.
Ana: Nice. For handoff: Jo will continue with billing spike, Li continues mem leak debug, Mike to ship shim patch, Sara to own the embeddings macro and customer comms. I'll handle coordination and update SLA notices if we need longer info.
Sara: For customer comms, suggest this short line: "We're aware of intermittent embeddings ingestion failures for some clients; engineers are investigating — we'll follow up within 2 hours." Thoughts?
Jo: Good. Add a link to the status page and include ticket number.
Ana: Blockers? Li: need a repro script from infra that runs long-lived sequences >=8k.
ops-bot: Incident timeline note created: INC-3130 assigned to Li, priority P1.
Mike: If anyone needs me for rollback testing, ping me in #eng-oncall.
Ana: OK team — check back in ~1.5h or sooner with any escalations. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've taken the action assigned.
Sara: :white_check_mark: — macro updated and canned reply added.
Jo: :white_check_mark: — billing work in progress.
Li: :white_check_mark: — have staging repro running, will update.
Mike: :white_check_mark: — shim PR in review.
Ana: Thanks — I'll post a short summary to the status page after the next update.
